h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in San Antonio with Defensive Driving

faqs.q: How much does it cost to dismiss a ticket in San Antonio?
faqs.a: The court cost is typically up to about $144 ($169 in a school zone), set by each court — some Bexar-area courts charge less. The TDLR-approved course is separate; ours is $28. See your court's page for the exact figure.

faqs.q: Can I take the San Antonio defensive driving course online?
faqs.a: Yes. After the court approves your request, a TDLR-approved 6-hour course can be done fully online and the certificate submitted. Every San Antonio-area court accepts a state-approved online course.

faqs.q: My ticket is from Converse / Alamo Heights / Leon Valley, not San Antonio. Does that matter?
faqs.a: The legal steps are the same, but you deal with that city's court, which sets its own fee, request method, and deadlines. Open its page in the table above.

faqs.q: How long do I have to complete the course?
faqs.a: Usually 90 days after the court grants your request. Request the course by your appearance date first, and don't pay the ticket — paying is a guilty plea and a conviction.

faqs.q: Does a dismissal keep it off my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A driving safety course dismissal keeps the charge off your driving record under Texas law, so it can't raise your insurance — unlike paying, which is a conviction.

courts.name: San Antonio Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Alamo Heights Municipal Court
courts.note: Alamo Heights charges $144 ($169 school zone) including a $10 admin fee — request by your appearance date.

courts.name: Balcones Heights Municipal Court
courts.note: Balcones Heights takes DSC requests only in writing — email or in person, never by phone. $144 fee.

courts.name: Castle Hills Municipal Court
courts.note: Castle Hills says don't order your driving record until the court approves you. $144 ($169 school zone).

courts.name: China Grove Municipal Court
courts.note: China Grove (Bexar County, FM-1516) hasn't posted its DSC fee and is open Mon–Thu — call (210) 648-4923 by your appearance date.

courts.name: Converse Municipal Court
courts.note: Converse takes DSC applications online but payment is due within 24 hours of approval. $144 fee.

courts.name: Elmendorf Municipal Court
courts.note: Elmendorf (Bexar County, US-181 SE of San Antonio) takes a DSC affidavit by your appearance date — call (210) 635-8210 for court costs; 90 days.

courts.name: Fair Oaks Ranch Municipal Court
courts.note: Fair Oaks Ranch (I-10 NW of San Antonio) takes DSC requests in person or by mail only — never pay online or it's a conviction; 90 days.

courts.name: Grey Forest Municipal Court
courts.note: Grey Forest (Bexar County, Scenic Loop near Helotes) hasn't posted its DSC fee and meets monthly — email or call (210) 695-3261 ext. 2.

courts.name: Helotes Municipal Court
courts.note: Helotes needs a notarized affidavit by certified mail (waived if you sign in person). $144 fee.

courts.name: Hill Country Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Hill Country Village (Bexar County, US-281 N) charges $144 due at request — don't start the course before approval; 90 days.

courts.name: Hollywood Park Municipal Court
courts.note: Hollywood Park (Bexar County, US-281 N) charges $144 — request by email or mail before your appearance date; 90 days, Type 3A record.

courts.name: Kirby Municipal Court
courts.note: Kirby's court page is still under construction and posts no DSC fee — request through the clerk before your monthly court date.

courts.name: Leon Valley Municipal Court
courts.note: Leon Valley needs a notarized request form and $144 ($169 school zone) by your appearance date — call before paying online.

courts.name: Live Oak Municipal Court
courts.note: Live Oak charges a flat $144, no personal checks, and paying online is a conviction. Get court approval first.

courts.name: Olmos Park Municipal Court
courts.note: Olmos Park (Bexar County, near downtown San Antonio) hasn't posted its DSC fee — submit your certificate by email, fax, mail, or in person; call (210) 824-3281.

courts.name: Saint Hedwig Municipal Court
courts.note: Saint Hedwig (Bexar County, FM-1346) hasn't posted its DSC fee and meets monthly — call (210) 667-9568 by your appearance date to request it.

courts.name: Sandy Oaks City Of Municipal Court
courts.note: Sandy Oaks (Bexar County, SE of San Antonio) charges $141 by money order — contact the court by your appearance date; 90 days to finish.

courts.name: Selma Municipal Court
courts.note: Selma's high-traffic I-35 court charges $144 ($169 school zone) and bars CDL holders even before the judge.

courts.name: Shavano Park Municipal Court
courts.note: Shavano Park's NW Military/1604 court takes DSC requests by your appearance date — fee due at request.

courts.name: Somerset Municipal Court
courts.note: Somerset (Bexar County, SW of San Antonio) charges a $10 admin fee plus court costs by mail or in person — no fax/email, no extensions.

courts.name: Terrell Hills Municipal Court
courts.note: Terrell Hills (San Antonio enclave) charges $144 ($169 school zone) — request in person or by mail with a notarized form by your court date.

courts.name: Universal City Municipal Court
courts.note: Universal City's mail-in DSC request needs photocopies, payment, and a stamped envelope — and 90 days means 90 days.

courts.name: Von Ormy Municipal Court
courts.note: Von Ormy (Bexar County, I-35 SW) — contact the court before paying online; a 60-day completion window and a $25 school-zone surcharge apply.

courts.name: Windcrest Municipal Court
courts.note: Windcrest takes DSC requests by email and charges a flat $144 — court approval required first.
